limitations: Static literal imports including import types; current controlled iOS entry, plus serviceWorkerRuntime required by the build helper. Not an independent compile or runtime result.

virtualTypescript.checkMethod: TypeScript createProgram with compiler options from canonical tsconfig; 1017 projected roots; compiler host supplies canonical Git bytes for every changed-but-unselected source and excludes every unselected added src file. Current installed locked node_modules provides packages. getPreEmitDiagnostics returned empty; no disk candidate or Xcode invocation.

publicAssets.recommendedStrategy: Keep all canonical f406 public blobs untouched; repin only this isolated descriptor to exact LF source bytes.

alternativePreserveOriginalBytes.instruction: If root instead preserves the original CRLF descriptor, upload these 209 exact current asset bytes with binary/base64-safe blob transport; then verify actual checkout bytes before build. Never claim LF and CRLF hashes are identical.

publicationContentScan.scope: Allowlisted local UTF-8 files; simple specific secret/local-profile signatures, not universal secret proof.

requiredExistingBaseFiles: all unchanged canonical src dependencies and 266 selected public assets
exclusions: new database fixtures and processor code
test browser profiles and local evidence
new source tests and PWA/Web entry changes not listed
optionalSourceOnlyAdditions: scripts/mobile/ios-simulator-build.test.mjs (reviewed tests, not currently invoked by the CI job)

notes: Create the tree from the canonical base tree plus only this allowlist. Never use the local V12 HEAD as parent or upload its reachable Git history.
Base assets remain unchanged under the recommended descriptor adaptation. All source inputs and resulting build ID must be measured freshly in CI.

Use create_blob base64 for the four PNG assets; content or SHA entries for text, exact modes 100644. The available create_tree/create_commit/create_branch/update_ref connector methods support this without authenticated gh shell.
Creating blobs/trees/commits is already a remote write; root must finish review and choose execution before any such call. Move only the exact isolated ref after verifying resulting tree/parent.
Narrow push trigger runs the tip of this branch without merge. Its matching workflow/helper path must be in the pushed diff; source-only later changes do not independently match narrow paths.

sources.supports: base_tree preserves unchanged files; additions/replacements are committed before updating one ref.
UTF-8/base64 blob transport and Contents write permission.
Nonforce ref updates and Contents/Workflows permission requirements.
Push uses branch tip including workflows not merged into default; branches and paths are conjunctive.

limits: This report is not an Xcode/macOS compile result.
Virtual TypeScript compiler read the projected baseline source tree from Git and selected runtime files from disk; it did not materialize or build the candidate.
Four canonical iOS PNG files have local hash records; public artifact disclosure and remote CI execution remain root decisions.
The known later main commits are intentionally outside this historical native-host/Xcode probe.
